title: Widget Library and Management

useCases.title: Browse available widgets
postconditions: User sees list of available widget types with previews
mainFlow: 3. System displays widget types: Chart, Table, Metric, Custom
4. Each widget type shows icon and description
5. User can search or filter by category
6. User clicks widget type to select and add to dashboard

useCases.title: Configure widget data source
preconditions: Widget has been added to dashboard
postconditions: Widget is bound to data source
mainFlow: 3. User selects data source (SQL query, API endpoint, static data)
4. User configures data transformation if needed
6. System queries data source and renders widget
alternateFlows: 3a. User can select from saved data source queries
3b. User can write custom SQL query

domainEntities.name: Widget
domainEntities.persistenceRationale: Widget definitions are code/configuration, not runtime data

microflows.name: ACT_Widget_LoadData
microflows.trigger: Page load and on data refresh

buildComposition.search: Filter by widget type or keyword

security.model: Widget types are public; data sources may have restricted access based on creator role

crossCuttingRequirements: Widget rendering must handle null/empty data gracefully
Widget data queries must timeout after 30 seconds
Widget instances must validate data source connectivity
